behavior: A user queues at most 20 client emails a day across all profiles: Send to client, reminders, retainer months and job changes
acceptance: Send to client answers 429 rate_limited once the user's profiles queued 20 client emails in 24 h, of any kind and from any profile.
Over the cap a reminder is not queued and goes out when there is room; a retainer month and a job change are still made, without the email.
The per-invoice and per-job limits stay; the old per-profile caps are replaced by the per-user cap.
PLAN lists an own email provider in place of Resend after the MVP; R-94, R-96, R-98, R-107 and api.md name the cap.
notes: 2026-10-19 review fail by subagent: Blockers: (1) apps/backend/internal/httpapi/tests/invoices_send_test.go:126: the cross-profile test passes on the old code. The last send goes to 'first', which already has 16 sends (line 117). The one-send-per-invoice limit answers 429 before the user cap is read. So no test proves the cap counts other profiles, the audit's main point. Fix: put the 16 old sends on another invoice, or send a fresh invoice of the first profile. (2) docs/PROJECT.md:145 (R-96) and :147 (R-98) do not name the cap; acceptance 4 asks for it. R-98 still says each month is emailed, but a month past the cap now goes without its email. R-96 reminders can now wait past their day. openapi.yaml:1877 (repeat) also says each month is emailed. Minor: invoiceapi/invoices.go:125-126 comment still names the removed invoice.MaxProfileSends. send.go:32-35 and job/change.go:38 comments still say the profile lock orders the sends and change emails; the user lock does that now. TestChangeEmailsPerDay passes on the old code; no test shows a job change counting other kinds or profiles. ClientEmailsSQL has no index on outbox_events.created_at, so each Send, change, retainer month and reminders round scans the whole outbox, which is never pruned; fine at MVP volume, add a partial index later. QueueReminders locks users and inserts in two snapshots; a user whose reminders turn on between them is not locked, so a concurrent Send could pass the cap by one (very narrow). FOR NO KEY UPDATE on users would be enough and would not block FK inserts. The R-116 first sentence has 28 words (D-84 max 25). Checked OK: the count joins invoice or job to profile to user, the three kinds and the 24 h window. Lock order is profile, then job or retainer, then user everywhere; reminders lock only users, in id order; no deadlock found. Reminders: row_number per user against room is right, NOT EXISTS keeps queued steps from using room, ON CONFLICT kept, params 1 to 5 right. Retry-After at the cap is the time until the oldest counted email is a day old. Nothing else queues a client email outside the cap. Ran: go test -count=1 on invoice, job, outbox and httpapi/tests at HEAD: all ok. The new tests on a scratch copy with the origin/main sources (plus a MaxClientEmails const): the reminders and retainer tests fail as they should; the cross-profile and job tests pass. Verify logs F249-20261019T181656Z-* all passed.
